name: Screen Orientation lock
plain: Forces the screen into portrait or landscape.
meaning: Controls how the person holds the phone. It reads nothing, but it can trap a page in one orientation.

access.prompt_ui: No prompt; page must be fullscreen on Chrome Android (or installed PWA)
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Forces the screen into portrait or landscape.

limits.headline: Can lock your screen to portrait or landscape, but only in full screen
limits.user_action: You tap Full screen or open an installed web app, then start a game or video.
can: Lock the screen to portrait or landscape
Unlock it again when you leave full screen
Work in installed web apps on Android
cannot: Lock the screen unless the page is full screen or installed on Android
Work in Safari, including on iPhone
Stay locked after you leave the page
Override your phone's own rotation lock in every case
limits.reach_label: While in full screen or installed
limits.differs: Android Chrome and Edge allow it in full screen. Safari and iPhone do not.

story.what_it_is: A page can force your screen to stay in portrait or landscape.

marketing.name: ScreenOrientation.lock()
marketing.pitch: MDN says the lock method locks the screen into a chosen orientation, usually in fullscreen.

story.for_you: You go full screen in a game or video and the phone flips to landscape and stays there, even if you tilt it.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for games and video where one way up is better. It reads nothing from you, but it can trap you in one view if misused.

use_cases.example: A browser racing game locks to landscape so steering with tilt works.
Cloud gaming on a phone browser forces landscape for the controls.
A video player locks to landscape when you go full screen.
A camera tool keeps a photo in the right direction.
A web document scanner keeps pages upright.
A sneaky ad forces landscape to fill the screen.

technical_bounds: Fullscreen or installed PWA required on Chrome
iOS Safari does not implement lock()

history.change: lock() ships on Android, fullscreen only
